name: Exponential Resonance Masking
description: Replaces the linear sum condition with an equivalent non-linear exponential equation $c_u^{c_v} + c_v^{c_u} = 3$. This masks the bipartite structure by forcing the model to evaluate the relationship over the domain {1, 2} to discover the $c_u \neq c_v$ constraint, breaking simple pattern matching.
